Set it before reproducing the user action—it does not inspect past traffic—then call get_paused_info/evaluate_

specs.name: navigate_page

specs.name: take_screenshot

specs.description: Get a meeting transcript as plain text.

specs.name: create_note
specs.description: Create a note.

specs.name: get_process_info
specs.description: Get current process ID, name, modules count and architecture.

specs.name: enum_modules
specs.description: List all loaded modules (DLLs) with their base addresses and sizes. Args: offset: Start index for pagination (default 0). limit: Maximum modules to return (default 100, max 10000). Returns JSON with: success, total, offset, limit, returned, modules.

specs.name: get_thread_list
specs.description: Get list of threads in the attached process. Args: offset: Start index for pagination (default 0). limit: Maximum threads to return (default 100, max 10000). Returns JSON with: success, total, offset, limit, returned, threads.

specs.name: get_symbol_address
specs.description: Resolve a symbol name (e.g., 'Engine.GameEngine') to an address.

specs.name: get_address_info
specs.description: Get symbolic name and module info for an address (Reverse of get_symbol_address).

specs.name: get_rtti_classname
specs.description: Try to identify the class name of an object at address using Run-Time Type Information.

specs.name: read_memory
specs.description: Read raw bytes from memory.

specs.name: read_integer
specs.description: Read a number from memory. Types: byte, word, dword, qword, float, double.

specs.name: read_pointer
specs.description: Read a pointer chain. Returns the final address and value.

specs.name: read_pointer_chain
specs.description: Follow a multi-level pointer chain and return analysis of every step.

specs.name: analyze_pointer_access
specs.description: Parse a captured memory access (instruction + register snapshot from a breakpoint/DBVM hit) into base register, displacement, and the concrete struct-base address for pointer-chain walk-back. Pure analysis; no process access. next_scan_value is the address to scan for (as a pointer) to find the next level up.

specs.name: validate_pointer_chains
specs.description: Resolve a list of candidate pointer chains and report which currently land on `target`. Each chain is {"base": <addr|symbol>, "offsets": [int,...]}. Returns only matches by default (token-frugal); set include_misses=true to also list non-matches. Re-run after a game restart with the new target to find chains that stay valid (the stable pointer). Max 5000 chains per call.

specs.name: checksum_memory
specs.description: Calculate MD5 checksum of a memory region to detect changes.

specs.name: scan_all
specs.description: Unified Memory Scanner (first scan). Args: value: Value to search for. Omit when scan_option is 'unknown'. type: Value type: byte, word, dword, qword, float, double, string. protection: +W-C (Writable, Not Copy-on-Write). scan_option: exact, unknown, between, bigger, smaller. value2: Upper bound for 'between'. Alternatively pass both bounds in value as "min,max" (e.g. "0,1").

specs.name: get_scan_results
specs.description: Get results from the last 'scan_all' operation. Args: offset: Start index for pagination (default 0). limit: Maximum results to return (default 100, max 10000). Preferred over 'max'. max: Deprecated alias for 'limit'. Use 'limit' instead. Returns JSON with: success, total, offset, limit, returned, results.

specs.name: next_scan
specs.description: Next scan to filter results from the last 'scan_all'. Args: value: Value to compare against. Not needed for increased/decreased/changed/unchanged. scan_type: exact, between, bigger, smaller, increased, decreased, increased_by, decreased_by, changed, unchanged. value2: Upper bound for 'between'. Alternatively pass both bounds in value as "min,max" (e.g. "0,1").

specs.name: write_integer
specs.description: Write a number to memory. Types: byte, word, dword, qword, float, double.

specs.name: write_memory
specs.description: Write raw bytes to memory.

specs.name: write_string
specs.description: Write a string to memory (ASCII or Wide/UTF-16).

specs.name: aob_scan
specs.description: Scan for an Array of Bytes (AOB) pattern. Example: '48 89 5C 24'.

specs.name: search_string
specs.description: Quickly search for a text string in memory.

specs.name: generate_signature
specs.description: Generate a unique AOB signature that can find this specific address again.

specs.name: get_memory_regions
specs.description: Get list of valid memory regions nearby common bases.

specs.name: enum_memory_regions_full
specs.description: Enumerate ALL memory regions in the process (Native EnumMemoryRegions). Args: offset: Start index for pagination (default 0). limit: Maximum regions to return (default 100, max 10000). Preferred over 'max'. max: Deprecated alias for 'limit'. Use 'limit' instead. Returns JSON with: success, total, offset, limit, returned, regions.

specs.name: disassemble
specs.description: Disassemble instructions starting at an address. Args: address: Target address (hex string or symbol). count: Number of instructions to generate (default 20). offset: Start index within the generated list for pagination (default 0). limit: Maximum instructions to return (default 100, max 10000). Returns JSON with: success, start_address, total, offset, limit, returned, instructions.

specs.name: get_instruction_info
specs.description: Get detailed info about a single instruction (size, bytes, opcode).

specs.name: find_function_boundaries
specs.description: Attempt to find the start and end of a function containing the address.

specs.name: analyze_function
specs.description: Analyze a function to find all CALL instructions output (calls made by this function).

specs.name: find_references
specs.description: Find instructions that access (reference) this address. Args: address: Target address to find references to. offset: Start index for pagination (default 0). limit: Maximum references to return (default 50, max 10000). Returns JSON with: success, target, total, offset, limit, returned, references, arch.

specs.name: find_call_references
specs.description: Find all locations that CALL this function. Args: function_address: Address of the function to find callers of. offset: Start index for pagination (default 0). limit: Maximum callers to return (default 100, max 10000). Returns JSON with: success, function_address, total, offset, limit, returned, callers.

specs.name: dissect_structure
specs.description: Use CE's auto-guess feature to interpret memory at address as a structure.

specs.name: set_breakpoint
specs.description: Set a hardware execution breakpoint. Non-breaking/Logging only.

specs.name: set_data_breakpoint
specs.description: Set a hardware data breakpoint (watchpoint). Types: 'r' (read), 'w' (write), 'rw' (access).

specs.name: remove_breakpoint
specs.description: Remove a breakpoint by its ID.

specs.name: list_breakpoints
specs.description: List all active breakpoints.

specs.name: clear_all_breakpoints
specs.description: Remove ALL breakpoints.

specs.name: get_breakpoint_hits
specs.description: Get hits for a specific breakpoint ID (or all if None). Set clear=True to flush buffer. Args: id: Breakpoint ID to query, or None for all breakpoints. clear: If True, flush the hit buffer after reading (default False). offset: Start index for pagination (default 0). limit: Maximum hits to return (default 100, max 10000). Returns JSON with: success, total, offset, limit, returned, hits.

specs.name: get_physical_address
specs.description: Translate Virtual Address to Physical Address (requires DBVM).

specs.name: start_dbvm_watch
specs.description: Start invisible DBVM hypervisor watch. Modes: 'w' (writes), 'r' (reads), 'x' (execute).

specs.name: stop_dbvm_watch
specs.description: Stop DBVM watch and return results.

specs.name: poll_dbvm_watch
specs.description: Poll DBVM watch logs WITHOUT stopping. Returns register state at each execution hit.

specs.name: dbk_get_cr0
specs.description: Read Control Register 0 (CR0) via the DBK kernel driver. Requires the DBK kernel driver to be loaded (CE Settings -> Debugger -> Kernelmode). Returns cr0 as a hex string.

specs.name: dbk_get_cr3
specs.description: Read Control Register 3 (CR3 — page-table base) via DBK or DBVM. Works when either the DBK kernel driver or the DBVM hypervisor is loaded. Returns cr3 as a hex string.

specs.name: dbk_get_cr4
specs.description: Read Control Register 4 (CR4) via the DBK kernel driver. Requires the DBK kernel driver to be loaded (CE Settings -> Debugger -> Kernelmode). Returns cr4 as a hex string.

specs.name: read_process_memory_cr3
specs.description: Read virtual memory using an explicit CR3 page-table base via DBK/DBVM. Bypasses the standard OS memory-translation path, making it effective for processes that hide memory from normal reads (e.g. anti-cheat analysis). Requires: DBK kernel driver or DBVM hypervisor loaded; a process must be attached. Args: cr3: CR3 value (hex string or integer) identifying the target page table. address: Virtual a

specs.name: write_process_memory_cr3
specs.description: Write to virtual memory using an explicit CR3 page-table base via DBK/DBVM. Bypasses the standard OS memory-translation path. Requires: DBK kernel driver or DBVM hypervisor loaded; a process must be attached. Args: cr3: CR3 value (hex string or integer) identifying the target page table. address: Virtual address to write to (hex string or symbol name). bytes: List of integer byte values to write.

specs.name: map_memory
specs.description: Map a kernel/physical address range into the CE usermode context via DBK. Returns a mapped_address that can be used for ordinary memory reads/writes. Call unmap_memory() with the same mapped_address when finished. Requires: DBK kernel driver loaded; a process must be attached. Args: address: Source address to map (hex string or symbol name). size: Number of bytes to map.

specs.name: unmap_memory
specs.description: Release a memory mapping created by map_memory(). The size parameter is accepted for API compatibility but unused internally; the MDL handle captured during map_memory() is used to release the mapping. Requires: DBK kernel driver loaded; a process must be attached. Args: mapped_address: The mapped address returned by a prior map_memory() call. size: Unused; kept for API symmetry with map_memory().

specs.name: dbk_writes_ignore_write_protection
specs.description: Toggle whether DBK memory writes bypass copy-on-write (CoW) protection. When enabled, writes go directly to the underlying physical page instead of triggering a page fault and creating a process-private copy. Useful when patching shared read-only pages across all processes simultaneously. Requires: DBK kernel driver loaded. Args: enable: True to bypass CoW; False to restore normal CoW behaviour.

specs.name: get_physical_address_cr3
specs.description: Translate a virtual address to its physical address using an explicit CR3. Unlike get_physical_address (which uses the currently attached process's CR3), this function lets you walk any process's page table — useful for cross-process physical memory analysis. Requires: DBK kernel driver or DBVM hypervisor loaded; a process must be attached. Args: cr3: CR3 value (hex string or integer) of the targe

specs.name: evaluate_lua
specs.description: Execute arbitrary Lua code in Cheat Engine.

specs.name: auto_assemble
specs.description: Run an AutoAssembler script (injection, code caves, etc).

specs.name: assemble_instruction
specs.description: Assemble a single x86/x64 instruction into bytes. Requires an attached process when an address is given (the address is used to resolve relative operands such as JMP targets). Returns {success, bytes: [int], size: int}. preference: 0=none, 1=short, 2=long, 3=far.

specs.name: auto_assemble_check
specs.description: Validate an Auto Assembler script for syntax errors without executing it. Returns {success, valid: bool, errors: [str]}. enable: True checks the [Enable] section; False checks [Disable]. target_self: if True, validates against CE's own process instead of the target.

specs.name: compile_c_code
specs.description: Compile C source code using CE's built-in TCC compiler. Does not require an attached process unless an address is provided. Returns {success, symbols: {name: address}, errors: [str]}. If TCC is unavailable: {success=false, error="TCC compiler not available", error_code="CE_API_UNAVAILABLE"}.

specs.name: compile_cs_code
specs.description: Compile C# source code using CE's .NET compiler (requires .NET 4+). Returns {success, assembly_handle: str} where assembly_handle is the path to the generated assembly. On .NET runtime absent: {success=false, error_code="CE_API_UNAVAILABLE"}.

specs.name: generate_api_hook_script
specs.description: Generate an Auto Assembler script that hooks a function and redirects it. Requires an attached process. address is the function to hook; target_address is where execution should jump after the hook. code_to_execute is optional extra AA code inserted into the generated script. Returns {success, script: str}.

specs.name: generate_code_injection_script
specs.description: Generate a boilerplate code-injection Auto Assembler script for an address. Requires an attached process. Returns {success, script: str} — the script can be used as a starting point for patching code at that location.

specs.name: ping
specs.description: Check connectivity and get version info.

specs.name: output_debug_string
specs.description: Post a message to the Windows debugger via OutputDebugString (readable with tools like DebugView).

specs.name: speak_text
specs.description: Speak text via Windows SAPI text-to-speech. Set english_only=True to force the English voice.

specs.name: play_sound
specs.description: Play a WAV sound file by filename. Path must not contain '..' directory traversal.

specs.name: beep
specs.description: Play a simple system beep sound.

specs.name: set_progress_state
specs.description: Set the Cheat Engine taskbar progress state. Valid states: none, normal, paused, error, indeterminate.

specs.name: set_progress_value
specs.description: Set the Cheat Engine taskbar progress bar position. Provide current value and maximum value.

specs.name: create_thread
specs.description: Execute Lua code in a new CE thread. SECURITY WARNING: This tool executes arbitrary Lua code inside CE's process, carrying the same risk as evaluate_lua. Only use with trusted code. Returns {success, thread_id}.

specs.name: get_global_variable
specs.description: Read a global variable from CE's main Lua state. Useful for reading values set by scripts running in other threads. Returns {success, value} where value is stringified via tostring().

specs.name: set_global_variable
specs.description: Write a global variable in CE's main Lua state. Useful for passing values to scripts running in other threads. Returns {success}.

specs.name: queue_to_main_thread
specs.description: Queue Lua code to run on CE's main thread without waiting for its result. SECURITY WARNING: This tool executes arbitrary Lua code inside CE's process on the main thread, carrying the same risk as evaluate_lua. Only use with trusted code. Returns {success}.

specs.name: check_synchronize
specs.description: Process queued main-thread calls (checkSynchronize). Call this from an infinite loop in the main thread when using threading and synchronize calls. Returns {success}.

specs.name: in_main_thread
specs.description: Check whether the current code is running in CE's main thread. Returns {success, is_main_thread}.

specs.name: run_command
specs.description: Execute a shell command in the host OS. SECURITY: Arbitrary code execution. REQUIRES environment variable CE_MCP_ALLOW_SHELL=1 at server startup. By default, this tool returns a PERMISSION_DENIED error. Args: command: Command path or name (e.g. "notepad.exe", "cmd.exe"). args: Arguments string. Returns JSON with: success, output, exit_code.

specs.name: shell_execute
specs.description: Invoke Windows ShellExecute. SECURITY: Arbitrary code execution. REQUIRES environment variable CE_MCP_ALLOW_SHELL=1 at server startup. Args: command: Command or file to execute. args: Arguments string. verb: ShellExecute verb. CE currently supports "open" only. working_dir: Working directory (empty for current). showcommand: Optional Win32 show command integer. Returns JSON with: success.

specs.name: file_exists
specs.description: Check whether a file exists at the given path. Returns {success, exists: bool}.

specs.name: delete_file
specs.description: Delete a file at the given path. Returns {success}. WARNING: This is a destructive operation. The file will be permanently deleted from disk. Path traversal sequences ('..') are blocked by the bridge. Use with extreme caution — there is no undo.

specs.name: get_file_list
specs.description: List files in the given directory path. Returns {success, count, files: [str]}.

specs.name: get_directory_list
specs.description: List subdirectories in the given directory path. Returns {success, count, directories: [str]}.

specs.name: get_temp_folder
specs.description: Return the path to the system temp folder. Returns {success, path: str}.

specs.name: get_file_version
specs.description: Get the version info of a file (major, minor, release, build). Returns {success, major, minor, release, build, version_string}.

specs.name: read_clipboard
specs.description: Read text from the system clipboard. Returns {success, text: str}.

specs.name: write_clipboard
specs.description: Write text to the system clipboard. Returns {success}.

specs.name: create_structure
specs.description: Create a new empty CE structure definition and add it to the global list. Args: name: The name for the new structure. Returns JSON with: success, structure_id.

specs.name: get_structure_by_name
specs.description: Find a CE structure by name in the global structure list. Args: name: The structure name to search for. Returns JSON with: success, structure_id, name, element_count, size.

specs.name: add_element_to_structure
specs.description: Add a new element to an existing CE structure. Args: structure_id: The structure ID returned by create_structure or get_structure_by_name. name: The element name. offset: The byte offset of the element within the structure. type: The variable type. Accepted values: byte, word, dword, qword, float, single, double, string, aob, bytearray, pointer. Returns JSON with: success, element_index.

specs.name: get_structure_elements
specs.description: Get all elements of a CE structure. Args: structure_id: The structure ID. Returns JSON with: success, structure_id, elements (list of {name, offset, type, size}).

specs.name: export_structure_to_xml
specs.description: Export a CE structure definition as XML. Args: structure_id: The structure ID. Returns JSON with: success, xml (XML string representation of the structure).

specs.name: delete_structure
specs.description: Delete a CE structure from the global list and free it. Args: structure_id: The structure ID to delete. Returns JSON with: success.

specs.name: load_table
specs.description: Load a Cheat Engine table (.ct) file into the current session. Args: filename: Path to the .ct or .cetrainer file to load. merge: If True, merge with the current table instead of replacing it. Returns JSON with: success.

specs.name: save_table
specs.description: Save the current cheat table to a file. Args: filename: Destination path for the .ct or .cetrainer file. protect: If True and the filename has a .cetrainer extension, protect it from normal reading. Returns JSON with: success.

specs.name: get_address_list
specs.description: List memory records in the current cheat table's address list. Args: offset: Zero-based index of the first record to return. limit: Maximum number of records to return (default 100). Returns JSON with: success, total, offset, limit, returned, records (list of {id, description, address, type, value, offsets, enabled}).

specs.name: get_memory_record
specs.description: Retrieve a single memory record by ID or description. Args: id: Unique numeric ID of the memory record. description: Description string of the memory record (used when id is not provided). Returns JSON with: success, record ({id, description, address, type, value, offsets, enabled}).

specs.name: create_memory_record
specs.description: Create a new memory record in the cheat table address list. Args: description: Human-readable label for the new entry. address: Address string (hex, symbol, or pointer expression) to watch. var_type: Variable type — byte, word, dword, qword, float, double, string, bytearray (default: dword). Returns JSON with: success, id, record ({id, description, address, type, value, offsets, enabled}).

specs.name: delete_memory_record
specs.description: Delete a memory record from the cheat table address list by ID. Args: id: Unique numeric ID of the memory record to delete. Returns JSON with: success.

specs.name: get_memory_record_value
specs.description: Read the current value of a memory record as a string. Args: id: Unique numeric ID of the memory record. Returns JSON with: success, value (string representation of the current value).

specs.name: set_memory_record_value
specs.description: Write a value to a memory record (and therefore to the target process memory). Args: id: Unique numeric ID of the memory record to update. value: New value as a string (e.g. "100", "3.14", "FF AA BB"). Returns JSON with: success.

specs.name: get_pixel
specs.description: Get the colour of a screen pixel at (x, y). Returns r, g, b channels and the raw COLORREF integer.

specs.name: get_mouse_pos
specs.description: Get the current mouse cursor position. Returns x and y screen coordinates.

specs.name: set_mouse_pos
specs.description: Move the mouse cursor to screen position (x, y).

specs.name: is_key_pressed
specs.description: Check whether a key is currently held down. vk is a Windows virtual-key code (e.g. 0x41 for 'A', 0x20 for Space, 0x01 for left mouse button). Returns pressed: bool.

specs.name: key_down
specs.description: Simulate pressing a key down (does NOT release it automatically). vk is a Windows virtual-key code (e.g. 0x41 for 'A', 0x20 for Space).

specs.name: key_up
specs.description: Release a key that was pressed with key_down. vk is a Windows virtual-key code (e.g. 0x41 for 'A', 0x20 for Space).

specs.name: do_key_press
specs.description: Simulate a full key press (down + up) for the given key. vk is a Windows virtual-key code (e.g. 0x41 for 'A', 0x20 for Space).

specs.name: get_screen_info
specs.description: Get the primary screen dimensions and DPI. Returns width, height (pixels) and dpi.

specs.name: find_window
specs.description: Find a top-level window by title and/or class name (system-wide, no process required). At least one of title or class_name must be provided. Returns {success, handle} on success or {success=false, error_code="NOT_FOUND"} when no matching window exists.

specs.name: get_window_caption
specs.description: Return the caption (title bar text) of a window given its handle (hex string).

specs.name: get_window_class_name
specs.description: Return the window class name of a window given its handle (hex string).

specs.name: get_window_process_id
specs.description: Return the process ID that owns a window given its handle (hex string).

specs.name: send_window_message
specs.description: Send a Windows message (WM_*) to a window. handle -- hex window handle string msg -- message ID (e.g. 0x000F for WM_PAINT) wparam -- WPARAM value (default 0) lparam -- LPARAM value (default 0) Returns {success, result} where result is the integer return value of SendMessage.

specs.name: show_message
specs.description: Show a modal message dialog in Cheat Engine. WARNING — NOT SAFE FOR AUTOMATED WORKFLOWS: This call BLOCKS the CE main thread until the user dismisses the dialog by clicking OK. Do not invoke from automation that expects a timely response. Returns {success} after the user closes the dialog.

specs.name: input_query
specs.description: Show a modal text-input dialog in Cheat Engine and return what the user typed. WARNING — NOT SAFE FOR AUTOMATED WORKFLOWS: This call BLOCKS the CE main thread until the user submits or cancels the dialog. Do not invoke from automation that expects a timely response. Returns {success, value, cancelled}. If cancelled is true, value is an empty string.

specs.name: show_selection_list
specs.description: Show a modal list-selection dialog in Cheat Engine. WARNING — NOT SAFE FOR AUTOMATED WORKFLOWS: This call BLOCKS the CE main thread until the user picks an item or cancels. Do not invoke from automation that expects a timely response. options -- list of strings to display Returns {success, selected_index, selected_value, cancelled}. selected_index is -1 and cancelled is true when the user dismisse

specs.name: aob_scan_unique
specs.description: Scan for an AOB pattern that must match exactly once. Returns {success, address} or error with count. Use this when you expect a signature to be unique in the process.

specs.name: aob_scan_module
specs.description: Scan for an AOB pattern restricted to a specific module's memory range. Returns {success, count, addresses: [str]}.

specs.name: aob_scan_module_unique
specs.description: Scan for an AOB pattern in a specific module that must match exactly once. Returns {success, address} or error with count.

specs.name: pointer_rescan
specs.description: Re-scan an existing pointer scan for a new value. Requires a prior pointer scan in CE. Returns {success, result_count}. Run a Pointer Scanner scan in CE first.

specs.name: create_persistent_scan
specs.description: Create a named, stateful memory scan session. Use the name with persistent_scan_* tools. Returns {success, scan_name}.

specs.name: persistent_scan_first_scan
specs.description: Run the first scan on a named persistent scan session. Types: byte, word, dword, qword, float, double, string. Scan options: exact, unknown, between, bigger, smaller. 'between' needs two bounds: pass value2, or put both in value as "min,max" (e.g. value="0,1"). 'unknown' takes no value. Returns {success, scan_name, count}.

specs.name: persistent_scan_next_scan
specs.description: Narrow down results with a next scan on a named persistent scan session. Scan options: exact, between, bigger, smaller, increased, decreased, increased_by, decreased_by, changed, unchanged. 'between' needs two bounds: pass value2, or put both in value as "min,max". Returns {success, scan_name, count}.

specs.name: persistent_scan_get_results
specs.description: Get paginated results from a named persistent scan session. Returns {success, total, offset, limit, results: [{address, value}]}.

specs.name: persistent_scan_destroy
specs.description: Destroy a named persistent scan session and free its memory. Returns {success, scan_name, destroyed}.

specs.name: copy_memory
specs.description: Copy memory between addresses. Methods: 0=target→target, 1=target→CE, 2=CE→target, 3=CE→CE. Returns dest_address allocated by CE if dest is None.

specs.name: compare_memory
specs.description: Compare two memory regions. Methods: 0=target/target, 1=addr1=target addr2=CE, 2=both CE. Returns equal flag and first_diff byte index (-1 if equal).

specs.name: write_region_to_file
specs.description: Write a memory region to a file. Filename must be an absolute path and must not contain '..' components.

specs.name: read_region_from_file
specs.description: Read a file into memory at the given destination address. Filename must be an absolute path and must not contain '..' components.

specs.name: md5_memory
specs.description: Calculate the MD5 hash of a memory region. Returns the hash as a hex string.

specs.name: md5_file
specs.description: Calculate the MD5 hash of a file on the CE host. Filename must not contain '..' components.

specs.name: create_section
specs.description: Create a Windows section (shared memory) of the given size. Returns a handle as a hex string.

specs.name: map_view_of_section
specs.description: Map a section into the target process. 'handle' is from create_section. 'address' is optional preferred base. Returns mapped_address.

specs.name: register_symbol
specs.description: Register a user-defined symbol with a given name and address. Args: name: Symbol name to register. address: Address to bind to the symbol (hex string or decimal). do_not_save: If True, this symbol is not persisted when the CE table is saved. Returns JSON with: success, name, address.

specs.name: unregister_symbol
specs.description: Remove a previously registered user-defined symbol. Args: name: Symbol name to unregister. Returns JSON with: success.

specs.name: enum_registered_symbols
specs.description: List all user-registered symbols. Returns JSON with: success, count, symbols (list of {name, address, module}).

specs.name: delete_all_registered_symbols
specs.description: Delete every user-registered symbol (both AA and Lua). Returns JSON with: success, deleted_count.

specs.name: enable_windows_symbols
specs.description: Trigger download and load of Windows PDB symbol files. Note: The actual PDB download and indexing is asynchronous; this call returns immediately once the process has been initiated by Cheat Engine. Returns JSON with: success.

specs.name: enable_kernel_symbols
specs.description: Enable kernel-mode symbol resolution (requires DBK driver). Returns JSON with: success. On failure returns error_code DBK_NOT_LOADED if the kernel driver is absent.

specs.name: get_symbol_info

specs.name: get_module_size
specs.description: Get the in-memory size of a loaded module. Requires an attached process. Args: module_name: Module filename (e.g. 'kernel32.dll'). Returns JSON with: success, size.

specs.name: load_new_symbols
specs.description: Scan for newly loaded modules and import their symbols. Returns JSON with: success.

specs.name: reinitialize_symbol_handler
specs.description: Perform a full reset and reload of the Cheat Engine symbol handler. Returns JSON with: success.

specs.name: debug_get_context
specs.description: Get the current thread's CPU register context. Set extra_regs=True to include XMM0-15 and FP0-7.

specs.name: debug_set_context
specs.description: Set CPU register values in the paused thread. Pass a dict like {\"RAX\": \"0x1234\", \"RIP\": \"0x140001000\"}.

specs.name: debug_get_xmm_pointer
specs.description: Return the CE-local memory address of an XMM register (0-15) for the currently broken thread.

specs.name: debug_set_last_branch_recording
specs.description: Enable or disable Intel LBR (Last Branch Recording). Requires kernel-mode debugger.

specs.name: debug_get_last_branch_record
specs.description: Get the from/to addresses of a Last Branch Record entry at the given index.

specs.name: debug_set_breakpoint_for_thread
specs.description: Set a breakpoint that fires only on a specific thread. trigger: execute|write|read|access.

specs.name: debug_remove_breakpoint_for_thread
specs.description: Remove a per-thread breakpoint at the given address for the given thread.

specs.name: debug_process
specs.description: Start the CE debugger for the currently opened process. interface: CE debugger interface enum. 0 = default, 1 = Windows native, 2 = VEH debugger, 3 = kernel debugger (DBK), 4 = DBVM. Requires a process to be attached. Returns {success, interface_used, interface_name}.

specs.name: debug_is_debugging
specs.description: Check whether the CE debugger has been started. Always safe to call; no process guard. Returns {success, is_debugging: bool}.

specs.name: debug_get_current_debugger_interface
specs.description: Return the active debugger interface used by CE. Returns {success, interface: int | null, interface_name: str}. interface_name values: 'windows_native', 'veh', 'kernel', 'mac_native', 'gdb', 'none'.

specs.name: debug_break_thread
specs.description: Break a specific thread by its thread ID. The thread may not stop instantly — it must be scheduled to run first. Requires the debugger to be attached. Returns {success}.

specs.name: debug_continue
specs.description: Continue execution from a breakpoint. method: one of 'run' (co_run), 'step_into' (co_stepinto), 'step_over' (co_stepover). Requires the debugger to be attached. Returns {success}.

specs.name: debug_detach
specs.description: Detach the debugger from the target process if possible. Returns {success, detached: bool}. Safe to call when no debugger is active.

specs.name: pause_process
specs.description: Pause (freeze) the currently opened process using CE's global pause() function. Requires a process to be attached. Returns {success}.

specs.name: unpause_process
specs.description: Resume (unfreeze) the currently opened process using CE's global unpause() function. Requires a process to be attached. Returns {success}.

specs.name: inject_dll
specs.description: Inject a DLL into the currently attached target process. Security warning: Executes arbitrary code in the target process. Use with caution. Args: filepath: Absolute path to the DLL or dylib to inject. skip_symbol_reload: If True, skips waiting for symbol reload after injection. Returns: JSON with {success}.

specs.name: execute_code
specs.description: Call a stdcall function with one argument at the given address in the target process. Security warning: Executes arbitrary code in the target process. Use with caution. Args: address: Address (hex string or symbol) of the function to call. param: Integer argument passed as the single parameter. timeout: Milliseconds to wait (-1 = indefinitely). Returns: JSON with {success, return_value}.

specs.name: execute_code_local
specs.description: Call a stdcall function inside Cheat Engine's own process (NOT the target). Security warning: Executes arbitrary code in the CE process. Use with caution. Useful for calling CE internal helpers or code loaded into CE itself. Args: address: Address within CE's memory space to call. param: Integer argument passed as the single parameter. Returns: JSON with {success, return_value}.

specs.name: execute_code_local_ex
specs.description: Call a function inside Cheat Engine's own process with explicit calling convention. Security warning: Executes arbitrary code in the CE process. Use with caution. call_method values: 0 = stdcall 1 = cdecl 2 = thiscall 3 = fastcall Args: address: Address within CE's memory space to call. args: List of arguments passed to the function. call_method: Integer calling convention identifier. Returns: JSO

specs.name: allocate_memory
specs.description: Allocate memory in the target process. Args: size: Number of bytes to allocate. base_address: Preferred base address as hex string (e.g. "0x140000000"). Optional. protection: Access flags — "r" (read-only), "rw" (read-write), "rx" (read-execute), "rwx" (read-write-execute, default). Returns JSON with: success, address.

specs.name: free_memory
specs.description: Free memory previously allocated in the target process. Args: address: Address of the region to free as hex string. size: Size of the region in bytes. Use 0 to let the OS determine it (default). Returns JSON with: success.

specs.name: allocate_shared_memory
specs.description: Create and map a shared memory region in the target process. The region is allocated with non-executable protection by default. Args: name: Unique name for the shared memory object. size: Size in bytes. Defaults to 4096 if the region does not yet exist. Returns JSON with: success, address.

specs.name: get_memory_protection
specs.description: Query the protection flags of a memory page in the target process. Args: address: Address to query as hex string. Returns JSON with: success, read (bool), write (bool), execute (bool), raw (PAGE_* name).

specs.name: set_memory_protection
specs.description: Change the protection flags of a memory region in the target process. Args: address: Start address as hex string. size: Size in bytes of the region to protect. read: Allow read access (default True). write: Allow write access (default True). execute: Allow execute access (default True). Returns JSON with: success.

specs.name: full_access
specs.description: Grant full read-write-execute access to a memory region (convenience wrapper). Args: address: Start address as hex string. size: Size in bytes of the region. Returns JSON with: success.

specs.name: allocate_kernel_memory
specs.description: Allocate non-paged kernel memory via the DBK driver. Requires the Cheat Engine kernel driver (DBK) to be loaded. Args: size: Number of bytes to allocate. Returns JSON with: success, address. Error codes: DBK_NOT_LOADED if the kernel driver is not active.

specs.name: open_process

specs.name: get_process_list
specs.description: Get the list of running processes on the system. Returns: JSON with {success, count, processes: [{pid: int, name: str}, ...]}.

specs.name: get_processid_from_name
specs.description: Look up the PID of a process by its executable name. Args: name: Process name to search for (e.g. "notepad.exe"). Returns: JSON with {success, process_id} or {success=false, error, error_code="NOT_FOUND"}.

specs.name: get_foreground_process

specs.name: create_process

Returns: JSON with {success, process_id}.

specs.name: get_opened_process_id

specs.name: get_opened_process_handle

specs.description: Adds a transition (e.g., cross dissolve) between two adjacent clips on the timeline.

specs.name: add_transition_to_clip
specs.description: Adds a transition to the beginning or end of a single clip. Check status and verified in the result: accepted_unverified means Premiere accepted the command but inspection could not prove the edit, so do not retry automatically.

specs.name: batch_add_transitions
specs.description: Adds a transition to all clip boundaries on a track. Useful for quickly adding cross dissolves or other transitions between every clip.

specs.name: color_correct
specs.description: Applies basic color correction adjustments to a video clip.

specs.name: apply_lut
specs.description: Applies a Look-Up Table (LUT) to a clip for color grading.

specs.name: add_keyframe
specs.description: Adds a keyframe to a clip component parameter at a specific time.

specs.name: remove_keyframe
specs.description: Removes a keyframe from a clip component parameter at a specific time.

specs.name: get_keyframes
specs.description: Gets all keyframes for a clip component parameter.

specs.name: export_sequence
specs.description: Renders and exports a sequence to a video file. This is for creating the final video.

specs.name: export_frame
specs.description: Exports a single frame from a sequence as an image file.

specs.name: add_to_render_queue
specs.description: Adds a sequence to the Adobe Media Encoder render queue.

specs.name: get_render_queue_status
specs.description: Reports whether render queue monitoring is available. This currently returns guidance for Adobe Media Encoder rather than live queue telemetry.

specs.name: export_as_fcp_xml
specs.description: Exports a sequence as Final Cut Pro XML.

specs.name: export_aaf
specs.description: Exports a sequence as an AAF file for interchange with other editing/audio applications.

specs.name: add_text_overlay
specs.description: Adds a text overlay from a Motion Graphics Template. Premiere cannot create titles from text alone — mogrtPath is required (a .mogrt file). Without it this tool fails immediately and must not be retried. Supports up to 4 text fields (text, text2, text3, text4) on the Nth AE.ADBE Text component.

specs.name: import_mogrt
specs.description: Imports a Motion Graphics Template (.mogrt) file into a sequence.

specs.name: import_mogrt_from_library
specs.description: Imports a Motion Graphics Template from a Creative Cloud Library.

specs.name: add_marker
specs.description: Adds a marker to the specified sequence for navigation or notes. The sequence does not have to be the active one.

specs.name: delete_marker
specs.description: Deletes a marker from the specified sequence. The sequence does not have to be the active one.

specs.name: update_marker
specs.description: Updates an existing marker\'s properties in the specified sequence. The sequence does not have to be the active one.

specs.name: list_markers
specs.description: Lists all markers in the specified sequence. The sequence does not have to be the active one.

specs.name: import_media
specs.description: Imports a media file (video, audio, image) into the current Premiere Pro project.

specs.name: import_fcp_xml
specs.description: Imports a Final Cut Pro 7 XML (XMEML) file into the current project. Premiere creates a new sequence with the cuts/clips defined in the XML. The import requests Premiere UI suppression, but malformed or unsupported XML can still be rejected by Premiere. Use legacy FCP7 XML, not modern FCPXML 1.x from Final Cut Pro X.

specs.name: import_edl
specs.description: Reports that CMX 3600 EDL import is unavailable through this dialog-safe MCP server. Premiere\'s EDL API opens an interactive sequence/source-media dialog that blocks CEP. Use import_fcp_xml for unattended timeline interchange instead.

specs.name: import_folder
specs.description: Imports all media files from a folder into the current Premiere Pro project.

specs.name: import_sequences_from_project
specs.description: Imports sequences from another Premiere Pro project file.

specs.name: create_project
specs.description: Creates a new Adobe Premiere Pro project. Use this when the user wants to start a new video editing project from scratch.

specs.name: open_project
specs.description: Opens an existing Adobe Premiere Pro project from a specified file path.

specs.name: save_project
specs.description: Saves the currently active Adobe Premiere Pro project.

specs.name: save_project_as
specs.description: Saves the current project with a new name and location.

specs.name: create_bin
specs.description: Creates a new bin (folder) in the project panel to organize media.

specs.name: move_item_to_bin
specs.description: Moves a project item into a different bin (folder).

specs.name: rename_project_item
specs.description: Renames a project item (sequence, bin, clip) by setting its name. Use this when duplicate_sequence does not propagate the new name to the project panel.

specs.name: create_subclip
specs.description: Creates a subclip from a project item with specified in/out points.

specs.name: relink_media
specs.description: Relinks an offline or moved media file to a new file path.

specs.name: set_color_label
specs.description: Sets the color label on a project item.

specs.name: get_color_label
specs.description: Gets the color label index of a project item.

specs.name: get_metadata
specs.description: Gets project metadata and XMP metadata for a project item.

specs.name: set_metadata
specs.description: Sets a project metadata value on a project item.

specs.name: get_footage_interpretation
specs.description: Gets the footage interpretation settings (frame rate, pixel aspect ratio, field type, etc.) for a project item.

specs.name: set_footage_interpretation
specs.description: Sets footage interpretation settings (frame rate, pixel aspect ratio) for a project item.

specs.name: consolidate_duplicates
specs.description: Consolidates duplicate media items in the project.

specs.name: refresh_media
specs.description: Refreshes the media for a project item, reloading it from disk.

specs.name: manage_proxies
specs.description: Checks proxy status, attaches a proxy file, or gets the proxy path for a project item.

specs.name: undo
specs.description: Performs an undo operation in Premiere Pro.

specs.name: create_sequence
specs.description: Creates a new sequence from a specific installed .sqpreset file without opening Premiere\'s New Sequence dialog. For footage-driven edits, prefer create_sequence_from_clips; for an empty copy of an existing sequence, use duplicate_sequence with clearContents=true.

specs.name: duplicate_sequence
specs.description: Creates a copy of an existing sequence with a new name. Set clearContents=true to get an EMPTY copy that inherits the source sequence\'s exact settings (frame rate, resolution, track layout) — the reliable way to auto-create a correctly-specced blank target, since create_sequence ignores frame rate.

specs.name: delete_sequence
specs.description: Deletes a sequence from the project.

specs.name: get_sequence_settings
specs.description: Gets the settings for a sequence (resolution, framerate, etc.).

specs.name: set_sequence_settings
specs.description: Updates sequence settings. Applies width, height, frameRate and pixelAspectRatio, reads the values back afterwards, and reports any field Premiere accepted but did not actually change. Frame size CAN be changed after creation, contrary to an earlier note in this codebase.

specs.name: set_active_sequence
specs.description: Sets the active sequence in the project.

specs.name: get_active_sequence
specs.description: Gets information about the currently active sequence.

specs.name: auto_reframe_sequence
specs.description: Automatically reframes a sequence to a new aspect ratio using AI-powered motion tracking.

specs.name: create_subsequence
specs.description: Creates a subsequence from the in/out points of a sequence.

specs.name: set_sequence_in_out_points
specs.description: Sets the in and/or out points on a sequence timeline.

specs.name: get_sequence_in_out_points
specs.description: Gets the in and out points of a sequence timeline.

specs.name: set_work_area
specs.description: Sets the work area in/out points for a sequence.

specs.name: get_work_area
specs.description: Gets the work area in/out points for a sequence.

specs.name: create_caption_track
specs.description: Creates a caption track on a sequence from an imported caption/subtitle file (e.g. an .srt imported via import_media). Pass the SRT project item ID directly.

specs.name: read_sequence_captions
specs.description: Reads caption tracks of a sequence, returning each caption clip as { start, end, text } in seconds. IMPORTANT: Premiere Pro exposes no caption-read API in its scripting DOM, so in practice this returns trackCount:0 / captions:[] even when the sequence HAS a working caption track. The response field captionReadSupported:false (plus note) signals this — a 0 result does NOT mean the sequence has no c

specs.name: add_to_timeline
specs.description: Adds a media clip from the project panel to a sequence timeline at a specific track and time.

specs.name: add_to_timeline_batch
specs.description: Places MANY clips onto one sequence in a single round-trip — the fast path for rebuilding a whole edit (e.g. a Descript/EDL stringout). Equivalent to calling add_to_timeline (overwrite) once per clip, but ~50x faster because it loops inside one ExtendScript pass instead of one file round-trip per clip. Each clip supports per-clip linkAudio and sourceInPoint/sourceOutPoint (Source-monitor in/out).

specs.name: remove_from_timeline
specs.description: Removes a clip from the timeline. Pass sequenceId when the clip ID came from list_sequence_tracks for a non-active sequence.

specs.name: move_clip
specs.description: Moves a clip along the timeline, keeping it on its current track. To change tracks, use move_clip_to_track: that call restores source in/out after a remove-and-reinsert, refuses an occupied destination unless overwrite is true, and gives the clip a new id.

specs.name: trim_clip
specs.description: Adjusts the in and out points of a clip on the timeline, effectively shortening it.

specs.name: split_clip
specs.description: Splits a clip at a specific time point, creating two separate clips.

specs.name: razor_timeline_at_time
specs.description: Cuts across multiple tracks in a sequence at an absolute timeline time. If no track arrays are provided, all video and audio tracks are cut.

specs.name: duplicate_clip
specs.description: Duplicates a clip on the timeline.

specs.name: reverse_clip
specs.description: Reverses the playback of a clip.

specs.name: enable_disable_clip
specs.description: Enables or disables a clip on the timeline.

specs.name: replace_clip
specs.description: Replaces a clip on the timeline with another media item.

specs.name: get_clip_properties
specs.description: Gets detailed properties of a clip, INCLUDING current Motion values (opacity/scale/rotation/position). Position is returned both normalized (0..1) and in PIXELS (

specs.name: set_clip_properties
specs.description: Sets Motion properties of a clip (opacity, scale, rotation, position).

specs.name: set_clip_properties_batch
specs.description: Applies Motion properties (opacity/scale/rotation/position) to MANY clips in a single round-trip — the fast path for per-speaker framing across a whole rebuilt edit. ~50x faster than one set_clip_properties call per clip. Returns a per-clip result array; each result carries an

specs.name: stabilize_clip
specs.description: Applies video stabilization to reduce camera shake.

specs.name: speed_change
specs.description: Changes the playback speed of a clip.

specs.name: get_playhead_position
specs.description: Gets the current playhead (CTI) position in the specified sequence.

specs.name: set_playhead_position
specs.description: Sets the playhead (CTI) position in the specified sequence.

specs.name: get_selected_clips
specs.description: Gets all currently selected clips in the specified sequence.

specs.name: detect_scene_edits
specs.description: Detects scene changes in selected clips and optionally adds cuts or markers.

specs.name: link_audio_video
specs.description: Links or unlinks audio and video components of a clip.

specs.name: add_track
specs.description: Adds a new video or audio track to the sequence.

specs.name: delete_track
specs.description: Deletes a video or audio track from the specified sequence. The sequence does not have to be the active one, but it does have to be open in Premiere: there is no DOM track-deletion API, so this falls through to the QE DOM, which only reaches sequences Premiere has open. A sequence QE cannot address is reported by name rather than deleted from the wrong timeline. Caption track deletion is accepted

specs.name: lock_track
specs.description: Locks or unlocks a track to prevent/allow editing. The sequence does not have to be the active one.

specs.name: toggle_track_visibility
specs.description: Shows or hides a video track by toggling its output (the eye icon) in the specified sequence. The sequence does not have to be the active one. This is track OUTPUT, not track targeting -- use set_target_track for the V1/A1 patch buttons.

specs.name: build_motion_graphics_demo
specs.description: Generates clean demo stills, creates a sequence, lays the shots out on the timeline, adds dissolves, and applies subtle scale animation for a polished minimalist ad-style demo.

specs.name: assemble_product_spot
specs.description: Builds a production-oriented promo timeline from real media assets. Supports either template defaults or an explicit clipPlan for LLM-directed pacing, transitions, motion, trims, and per-clip effects.

specs.name: build_brand_spot_from_mogrt_and_assets
specs.description: Builds a branded ad assembly from real media assets, supports optional MOGRT overlay, and allows explicit clipPlan control. Default polish is optional so creative direction can come from LLM planning instead of hardcoded passes.

specs.name: search_tools
specs.description: Search the Premiere tool catalog with a BM25 natural-language query or a regex pattern, then call invoke_tool. Use this instead of expecting 280 editing tools in the MCP tool list. Empty query lists categories. Default 5 matches.

specs.name: get_tool_schema
specs.description: Return the full JSON input schema for one Premiere tool name from search_tools. After reading it, call invoke_tool.

specs.name: invoke_tool
specs.description: Run a Premiere tool by exact name. Use after search_tools. Hosts that only advertise the small always-on set cannot call trim_clip etc. as top-level MCP tools.

specs.name: discovery
specs.description: Install metadata and OpenAPI

specs.name: mcp
specs.description: MCP client config and server cards

specs.name: generate_mermaid_diagram
specs.description: Generate mermaid diagram and chart with mermaid syntax dynamically. Mermaid is a JavaScript based diagramming and charting tool that uses Markdown-inspired text definitions and a renderer to create and modify complex diagrams. The main purpose of Mermaid is to help documentation catch up with development.

specs.name: list_projects
specs.description: Lists available GCP projects

specs.name: create_project
specs.description: Creates a new GCP project and attempts to attach it to the first available billing account. A project ID can be optionally specified; otherwise it will be automatically generated.

specs.name: list_services
specs.description: Lists all Cloud Run services in a given project.

specs.name: get_service
specs.description: Gets details for a specific Cloud Run service.

specs.name: get_service_log
specs.description: Gets Logs and Error Messages for a specific Cloud Run service.

specs.name: deploy_local_folder
specs.description: Deploy a local folder to Cloud Run. Takes an absolute folder path from the local filesystem that will be deployed. Use this tool if the entire folder content needs to be deployed.

specs.name: deploy_file_contents
specs.description: Deploy files to Cloud Run by providing their contents directly. Takes an array of file objects containing filename and content. Use this tool if the files only exist in the current chat context.

specs.name: deploy_container_image
specs.description: Deploys a container image to Cloud Run. Use this tool if the user provides a container image URL.

specs.name: do-alterx
specs.description: Execute Alterx, a tool that generates domain wordlists using pattern-based permutations for subdomain discovery and DNS enumeration

specs.name: amass
specs.description: Advanced subdomain enumeration and reconnaissance tool

specs.name: do-arjun
specs.description: Run Arjun to discover hidden HTTP parameters

specs.name: do-assetfinder
specs.description: Find related domains and subdomains using assetfinder for a given target.

specs.name: do-cero
specs.description: Execute Cero, a high-performance certificate-based subdomain enumeration tool. It connects to specified targets over TLS, extracts domain names from certificates (e.g., SAN fields), and outputs discovered hostnames. Useful for reconnaissance and OSINT tasks.

specs.name: do-commix
specs.description: Run Smuggler to detect HTTP Request Smuggling vulnerabilities

specs.name: crtsh
specs.description: Discovers subdomains from SSL certificate logs

specs.name: do-ffuf
specs.description: Run ffuf with specified URL

specs.name: gowitness-screenshot
specs.description: Capture screenshot of the given URL using gowitness scan single. Can save to directory or return as binary data.

specs.name: gowitness-report
specs.description: Generate a report from gowitness screenshots and data

specs.name: gowitness-batch-screenshot
specs.description: Capture screenshots of multiple URLs using gowitness scan file command

specs.name: gowitness-read-binary
specs.description: Read a screenshot file and return it as binary data

specs.name: gowitness-list-screenshots
specs.description: List all screenshot files in a directory

specs.name: analyze-http-header
specs.description: Perform security analysis of HTTP response headers for a web application. This tool examines HTTP headers against OWASP security best practices, identifying both potentially dangerous headers that should be removed and recommended security headers that are missing. Results include specific recommendations for improving security posture.

specs.name: httpx
specs.description: Scans the given target domains and detects active HTTP/HTTPS services on ports like 80 and 443.

specs.name: do-katana
specs.description: Performs fast and configurable web crawling on the given target URLs, identifying endpoints, parameters, and JS-based links.

specs.name: do-masscan
specs.description: Run masscan with specified target MASSCAN is a fast port scanner. The primary input parameters are the IP addresses/ranges you want to scan, and the port numbers.

specs.name: scanFile
specs.description: Scan a file that has already been uploaded to MobSF. This tool analyzes the uploaded mobile application for security vulnerabilities and provides a comprehensive security assessment report.

specs.name: uploadFile
specs.description: Upload a mobile application file (APK, IPA, or APPX) to MobSF for security analysis. This is the first step before scanning and must be done prior to using other analysis functions.

specs.name: getScanLogs
specs.description: Retrieve detailed scan logs for a previously analyzed mobile application using its hash value. These logs contain information about the scanning process and any issues encountered.

specs.name: getJsonReport
specs.description: Generate and retrieve a comprehensive security analysis report in JSON format for a scanned mobile application. This report includes detailed findings about security vulnerabilities, permissions, API calls, and other security-relevant information.

specs.name: getRecentScans
specs.description: Retrieve a list of recently performed security scans on the MobSF server, showing mobile applications that have been analyzed, their statuses, and basic scan information.

specs.name: do-nmap
specs.description: Run nmap with specified taget

specs.name: do-nuclei
specs.description: Execute Nuclei, an advanced vulnerability scanner that uses YAML-based templates to detect security vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and exposures in web applications and infrastructure. Nuclei offers fast scanning with a vast template library covering various security checks.

specs.name: get-nuclei-tags
specs.description: Get Nuclei Tags

specs.name: do-scoutsuite-aws
specs.description: Performs an AWS cloud security audit using Scout Suite for the given target settings, allowing service/region filtering and multiple authentication methods.

specs.name: shuffledns
specs.description: DNS Brute force

specs.name: do-smuggler
specs.description: Run Smuggler to detect HTTP Request Smuggling vulnerabilities

specs.name: do-sqlmap
specs.description: Run sqlmap with specified URL

specs.name: do-sslscan
specs.description: Execute SSLScan, a comprehensive SSL/TLS scanner that identifies supported cipher suites, SSL/TLS versions, certificate information, and security vulnerabilities in SSL/TLS configurations of web servers and other services. It helps security professionals assess the security posture of SSL/TLS implementations.

specs.name: do-waybackurls
specs.description: Execute Waybackurls, a tool that fetches known URLs from the Wayback Machine archive for a given domain. This helps in discovering historical endpoints, forgotten API paths, and potentially vulnerable URLs that might not be directly accessible or linked from the current version of the website.

specs.name: do-wpscan
specs.description: Run wpscan to analyze wordpress web sites

specs.name: hset
specs.description: Set a field in a hash stored at key with an optional expiration time. Args: name: The Redis hash key. key: The field name inside the hash. value: The value to set. expire_seconds: Optional; time in seconds after which the key should expire. Returns: A success message or an error message.

specs.name: hget
specs.description: Get the value of a field in a Redis hash. Args: name: The Redis hash key. key: The field name inside the hash. Returns: The field value or an error message.

specs.name: hdel
specs.description: Delete a field from a Redis hash. Args: name: The Redis hash key. key: The field name inside the hash. Returns: A success message or an error message.

specs.name: hgetall
specs.description: Get all fields and values from a Redis hash. Args: name: The Redis hash key. Returns: A dictionary of field-value pairs or an error message.

specs.name: hexists
specs.description: Check if a field exists in a Redis hash. Args: name: The Redis hash key. key: The field name inside the hash. Returns: True if the field exists, False otherwise.

specs.name: set_vector_in_hash
specs.description: Store a vector as a field in a Redis hash. Args: name: The Redis hash key. vector_field: The field name inside the hash. Unless specifically required, use the default field name vector: The vector (list of numbers) to store in the hash. Returns: True if the vector was successfully stored, False otherwise.

specs.name: get_vector_from_hash
specs.description: Retrieve a vector from a Redis hash and convert it back from binary blob. Args: name: The Redis hash key. vector_field: The field name inside the hash. Unless specifically required, use the default field name Returns: The vector as a list of floats, or an error message if retrieval fails.

specs.name: json_set
specs.description: Set a JSON value in Redis at a given path with an optional expiration time. Args: name: The Redis key where the JSON document is stored. path: The JSON path where the value should be set. value: The JSON value to store (as JSON string, or will be auto-converted). expire_seconds: Optional; time in seconds after which the key should expire. Returns: A success message or an error message.

specs.name: json_get
specs.description: Retrieve a JSON value from Redis at a given path. Args: name: The Redis key where the JSON document is stored. path: The JSON path to retrieve (default: root '$'). Returns: The retrieved JSON value or an error message.

specs.name: json_del
specs.description: Delete a JSON value from Redis at a given path. Args: name: The Redis key where the JSON document is stored. path: The JSON path to delete (default: root '$'). Returns: A success message or an error message.

specs.name: lpush
specs.description: Push a value onto the left of a Redis list and optionally set an expiration time.

specs.name: rpush
specs.description: Push a value onto the right of a Redis list and optionally set an expiration time.

specs.name: lpop
specs.description: Remove and return the first element from a Redis list.

specs.name: rpop
specs.description: Remove and return the last element from a Redis list.

specs.name: lrange
specs.description: Get elements from a Redis list within a specific range. Returns: str: A JSON string containing the list of elements or an error message.

specs.name: llen
specs.description: Get the length of a Redis list.

specs.name: lrem
specs.description: Remove elements from a Redis list. Args: name: The name of the list count: Number of elements to remove (0 = all, positive = from head, negative = from tail) element: The element value to remove Returns: A string indicating the number of elements removed.

specs.name: delete
specs.description: Delete a Redis key. Args: key (str): The key to delete. Returns: str: Confirmation message or an error message.

specs.name: type
specs.description: Returns the string representation of the type of the value stored at key Args: key (str): The key to check. Returns: str: The type of key, or none when key doesn't exist

specs.name: expire
specs.description: Set an expiration time for a Redis key. Args: name: The Redis key. expire_seconds: Time in seconds after which the key should expire. Returns: A success message or an error message.

specs.name: rename
specs.description: Renames a Redis key from old_key to new_key. Args: old_key (str): The current name of the Redis key to rename. new_key (str): The new name to assign to the key. Returns: Dict[str, Any]: A dictionary containing the result of the operation. On success: {"status": "success", "message": "..."} On error: {"error": "..."}

specs.name: publish
specs.description: Publish a message to a Redis channel. Args: channel: The Redis channel to publish to. message: The message to send. Returns: A success message or an error message.

specs.name: subscribe
specs.description: Subscribe to a Redis channel and return a reusable subscription handle. Args: channel: The Redis channel to subscribe to. Returns: A dictionary containing the subscription ID or an error message.

specs.name: psubscribe
specs.description: Subscribe to Redis channels using a pattern. Args: pattern: The Redis channel pattern to subscribe to. Returns: A dictionary containing the subscription ID or an error message.

specs.name: read_messages
specs.description: Read pending pub/sub messages for an existing subscription. Args: subscription_id: The ID returned by subscribe() or psubscribe(). timeout_ms: Time to wait for messages in milliseconds. Use 0 for non-blocking. max_messages: Maximum number of messages to return in one call. Returns: A dictionary containing the collected messages or an error message.

specs.name: unsubscribe
specs.description: Unsubscribe and close an existing pub/sub subscription. Args: subscription_id: The ID returned by subscribe() or psubscribe(). Returns: A dictionary describing the closed subscription or an error message.

specs.name: get_indexes
specs.description: List of indexes in the Redis database Returns: str: A JSON string containing the list of indexes or an error message.

specs.name: get_index_info
specs.description: Retrieve schema and information about a specific Redis index using FT.INFO. Args: index_name (str): The name of the index to retrieve information about. Returns: str: Information about the specified index or an error message.

specs.name: get_indexed_keys_number
specs.description: Retrieve the number of indexed keys by the index Args: index_name (str): The name of the index to retrieve information about. Returns: str: Number of indexed keys as a string

specs.name: vector_search_hash
specs.description: Perform a KNN vector similarity search using Redis 8 or later version on vectors stored in hash data structures. Args: query_vector: List of floats to use as the query vector. index_name: Name of the Redis index. Unless specifically specified, use the default index name. vector_field: Name of the indexed vector field. Unless specifically required, use the default field name k: Number of nearest ne

specs.name: dbsize
specs.description: Get the number of keys stored in the Redis database

specs.name: info
specs.description: Get Redis server information and statistics. Args: section: The section of the info command (default, memory, cpu, etc.). Returns: A dictionary of server information or an error message.

specs.name: client_list
specs.description: Get a list of connected clients to the Redis server.

specs.name: sadd
specs.description: Add a value to a Redis set with an optional expiration time. Args: name: The Redis set key. value: The value to add to the set. expire_seconds: Optional; time in seconds after which the set should expire. Returns: A success message or an error message.

specs.name: srem
specs.description: Remove a value from a Redis set. Args: name: The Redis set key. value: The value to remove from the set. Returns: A success message or an error message.

specs.name: smembers
specs.description: Get all members of a Redis set. Args: name: The Redis set key. Returns: A list of values in the set or an error message.

specs.name: zadd
specs.description: Add a member to a Redis sorted set with an optional expiration time. Args: key (str): The sorted set key. score (float): The score of the member. member (str): The member to add. expiration (int, optional): Expiration time in seconds. Returns: str: Confirmation message or an error message.

specs.name: zrange

specs.name: smart_cron

specs.name: smart_process
specs.description: Intelligent process management with smart caching (unmeasured design target: 88%+ token reduction). Start, stop, monitor processes with resource tracking and cross-platform support.

specs.name: smart_service
specs.description: Intelligent service management with smart caching (unmeasured design target: 86%+ token reduction). Manage systemd, Windows Services, and Docker containers with health monitoring and dependency tracking.

specs.name: smart_user
specs.description: Intelligent user and permission management with smart caching (unmeasured design target: 86%+ token reduction). Manage users, groups, permissions, ACLs, and perform security audits across Windows, Linux, and macOS.

specs.name: authenticate
specs.description: Authenticates with the sample XDR server using credentials provided at startup. Returns: A JSON string with the authentication result.

specs.name: get_recent_login
specs.description: Retrieves 3 fictitious recent logins for a user from the IDP system. Args: access_token: The access token obtained from authentication. user_name: The user to query (e.g., 'oleg'). Returns: A JSON string with fictitious login details.

specs.name: get_user_trust_assessment
specs.description: Retrieves a fictitious trust assessment score for a given user. Args: access_token: The access token obtained from authentication. user_name: The name of the user to assess (e.g., 'oleg'). Returns: A JSON string containing a fictitious trust assessment.

specs.name: get_host_information
specs.description: Retrieves fictitious information for a given host from the XDR system. Args: access_token: The access token obtained from authentication. host_name: The name of the host to query (e.g., 'web-server-iowa'). Returns: A JSON string with fictitious host information.

specs.name: get_alerts_for_host
specs.description: Retrieves 10 fictitious alerts for a given host. Args: access_token: The access token obtained from authentication. host_name: The name of the host to query (e.g., 'web-server-iowa'). Returns: A JSON string containing a list of 10 fictitious alerts.

Args: id (required): Google Threat Intelligence identifier. Returns: A collection object. Put attentio

specs.description: Retrieves timeline events from the given collection, when available. This is super valuable curated information produced by security analysits at Google Threat Intelligence. We should fetch this information for campaigns and threat actors always. It's common to display the events grouped by the "event_category" field. Args: id (required): Collection identifier Return: List of events related to the

specs.name: get_collection_mitre_tree
specs.description: Retrieves the Mitre tactics and techniques associated with a threat. Args: id (required): Collection identifiers. Return: A dictionary including the tactics and techniques associated to the given threat.

specs.name: create_collection
specs.description: Creates a new collection in Google Threat Intelligence. Ask for the collection's privacy (public or private) if the user doesn't specify. Args: name (required): The name of the collection. description (required): A description of the collection. iocs (required): Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) to include in the collection. The items in the list can be domains, files, ip_addresses, or urls. At leas

specs.description: Allows updating a collection's attributes (such as name or description) Args: id (required): The ID of the collection to update. attributes: Available attributes in a collection: * name: string * description: string * private: boolean * tags: array of strings * alt_names: array of strings Returns: A dictionary representing the updated collection.

specs.name: get_collections_commonalities
specs.description: Retrieve the common characteristics or features (attributes / relationships) of the indicators of compromise (IoC) within a collection, identified by its ID. Args: collection_id (required): Collection identifier. Returns: Markdown-formatted string with the commonalities of the collection.

specs.description: Get a comprehensive file analysis report using its hash (MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256). Returns a concise summary of key threat details including detection stats, threat classification, and important indicators. Parameters: hash (required): The MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256 hash of the file to analyze. Example: '8ab2cf...', 'e4d909c290d0...', etc.

specs.name: get_file_behavior_report
specs.description: Retrieve the file behaviour report of the given file behaviour identifier. You can get all the file behaviour of a given a file by calling `get_entities_related_to_a_file` as the file hash and the `behaviours` as relationship name. The file behaviour ID is composed using the following pattern: "{file hash}_{sandbox name}". Args: file_behaviour_id (required): File behaviour ID. Returns: The file be

specs.name: get_file_behavior_summary
specs.description: Retrieve a summary of all the file behavior reports from all the sandboxes. Args: hash (required): MD5/SHA1/SHA256) hash that identifies the file. Returns: The file behavior summary.

specs.name: analyse_file
specs.description: Upload and analyse the file in VirusTotal. The file will be uploaded to VirusTotal and shared with the community. Args: file_path (required): Path to the file for analysis. Use absolute path. Returns: The analysis report.

specs.name: get_domain_report
specs.description: Get a comprehensive domain analysis report from Google Threat Intelligence. Args: domain (required): Domain to analyse. Returns: Report with insights about the domain.

specs.name: get_ip_address_report
specs.description: Get a comprehensive IP Address analysis report from Google Threat Intelligence. Args: ip_address (required): IP Address to analyze. It can be IPv4 or IPv6. Returns: Report with insights about the IP address.

specs.name: get_url_report
specs.description: Get a comprehensive URL analysis report from Google Threat Intelligence. Args: url (required): URL to analyse. Returns: Report with insights about the URL.

specs.name: get_game_state
specs.description: Get the current Slay the Spire 2 game state. Returns the full game state including player stats, hand, enemies, potions, etc. The state_type field indicates the current screen (combat, map, event, shop, fake_merchant, etc.). Args: format: "markdown" for human-readable output, "json" for structured data.

specs.name: get_profile
specs.description: Get the current profile's persistent progress summary. Includes character stats, discovered content, achievements, epochs, and global run totals for the active profile.

specs.name: get_compendium
specs.description: Get the active profile's Compendium-shaped progress summary. Mirrors the visible Compendium cards: Card Library, Relic Collection, Potion Lab, Bestiary, Character Stats, and Run History. This is a profile-level view, so it is useful at the main menu as well as during a run. Card/relic/potion rules text is still supplied by game state when those objects are visible in run-specific contexts.

specs.name: search_wiki
specs.description: Search discovered card and relic wiki entries for the active profile. Uses fuzzy matching over profile-unlocked content only, so agents can ask for a card or relic by approximate name without receiving the entire game catalog. Card results include both base and upgraded variants when the card can be upgraded. Args: query: Search text such as "ironclad perfect strike" or "silver spoon". item_type:

specs.name: list_profiles
specs.description: List the three profile slots and identify the active slot. The has_data field indicates whether a slot currently has progress data.

specs.name: switch_profile
specs.description: Switch to a profile slot through the game's profile UI. Use an empty slot to create or enter a fresh profile for testing. This cannot be used while a run is in progress. Args: profile_id: Profile slot to switch to. Must be 1, 2, or 3.

specs.name: delete_profile
specs.description: Delete an inactive profile slot. The active profile cannot be deleted through this tool. Switch away first if you intend to remove a slot after backing up any data you need. Args: profile_id: Profile slot to delete. Must be 1, 2, or 3.

specs.name: use_potion
specs.description: Use a potion from the player's potion slots. Works both during and outside of combat. Combat-only potions require an active battle. Args: slot: Potion slot index (as shown in game state). target: Entity ID of the target enemy (e.g. "JAW_WORM_0"). Required for enemy-targeted potions.

specs.name: discard_potion
specs.description: Discard a potion from the player's potion slots to free up space. Use this when all potion slots are full and you need room for incoming potions (e.g. before collecting a potion reward). Args: slot: Potion slot index to discard (as shown in game state).

specs.name: proceed_to_map
specs.description: Proceed from the current screen to the map. Works from: rewards screen, rest site, shop, fake merchant. Does NOT work for events — use event_choose_option() with the Proceed option's index.

specs.name: combat_play_card
specs.description: [Combat] Play a card from the player's hand. Args: card_index: Index of the card in hand (0-based, as shown in game state). target: Entity ID of the target enemy (e.g. "JAW_WORM_0"). Required for single-target cards.
