specs.name: combat_end_turn
specs.description: [Combat] End the player's current turn.

specs.name: combat_select_card
specs.description: [Combat Selection] Select a card from hand during an in-combat card selection prompt. Used when a card effect asks you to select a card to exhaust, discard, etc. This is different from deck_select_card which handles out-of-combat card selection overlays. Args: card_index: 0-based index of the card in the selectable hand cards (as shown in game state).

specs.name: combat_confirm_selection
specs.description: [Combat Selection] Confirm the in-combat card selection. After selecting the required number of cards from hand (exhaust, discard, etc.), use this to confirm the selection. Only works when the confirm button is enabled.

specs.name: rewards_claim
specs.description: [Rewards] Claim a reward from the post-combat rewards screen. Gold, potion, and relic rewards are claimed immediately. Card rewards open the card selection screen (state changes to card_reward). Args: reward_index: 0-based index of the reward on the rewards screen. Note that claiming a reward may change the indices of remaining rewards, so refer to the latest game state for accurate indices. Claim

specs.name: rewards_pick_card
specs.description: [Rewards] Select a card from the card reward selection screen. Args: card_index: 0-based index of the card to add to the deck.

specs.name: rewards_skip_card
specs.description: [Rewards] Skip the card reward without selecting a card.

specs.name: map_choose_node
specs.description: [Map] Choose a map node to travel to. Args: node_index: 0-based index of the node from the next_options list.

specs.name: rest_choose_option
specs.description: [Rest Site] Choose a rest site option (rest, smith, etc.). Args: option_index: 0-based index of the option from the rest site state.

specs.name: shop_purchase
specs.description: [Shop / Fake Merchant] Purchase an item from the shop. Works for both regular shops (state_type: shop) and the fake merchant event (state_type: fake_merchant). The fake merchant only sells relics. Args: item_index: 0-based index of the item from the shop state.

specs.name: event_choose_option
specs.description: [Event] Choose an event option. Works for both regular events and ancients (after dialogue ends). Also used to click the Proceed option after an event resolves. Args: option_index: 0-based index of the option from the event state.

specs.name: event_advance_dialogue
specs.description: [Event] Advance ancient event dialogue. Click through dialogue text in ancient events. Call repeatedly until options appear.

specs.name: deck_select_card
specs.description: [Card Selection] Select or deselect a card in the card selection screen. Used when the game asks you to choose cards from your deck (transform, upgrade, remove, discard) or pick a card from offered choices (potions, effects). For deck selections: toggles card selection. For choose-a-card: picks immediately. Args: card_index: 0-based index of the card (as shown in game state).

specs.name: deck_confirm_selection
specs.description: [Card Selection] Confirm the current card selection. After selecting the required number of cards, use this to confirm. If a preview is showing (e.g., transform preview), this confirms the preview. Not needed for choose-a-card screens where picking is immediate.

specs.name: deck_cancel_selection
specs.description: [Card Selection] Cancel the current card selection. If a preview is showing, goes back to the selection grid. For choose-a-card screens, clicks the skip button (if available). Otherwise, closes the card selection screen (only if cancellation is allowed).

specs.name: bundle_select
specs.description: [Bundle Selection] Open a bundle preview. Args: bundle_index: 0-based index of the bundle.

specs.name: bundle_confirm_selection
specs.description: [Bundle Selection] Confirm the currently previewed bundle.

specs.name: bundle_cancel_selection
specs.description: [Bundle Selection] Cancel the current bundle preview.

specs.name: relic_select
specs.description: [Relic Selection] Select a relic from the relic selection screen. Used when the game offers a choice of relics (e.g., boss relic rewards). Args: relic_index: 0-based index of the relic (as shown in game state).

specs.name: relic_skip
specs.description: [Relic Selection] Skip the relic selection without choosing a relic.

specs.name: treasure_claim_relic
specs.description: [Treasure] Claim a relic from the treasure chest. The chest is auto-opened when entering the treasure room. After claiming, use proceed_to_map() to continue. Args: relic_index: 0-based index of the relic (as shown in game state).

specs.name: crystal_sphere_set_tool

specs.name: crystal_sphere_click_cell

specs.name: crystal_sphere_proceed
specs.description: [Crystal Sphere] Continue after the Crystal Sphere minigame finishes.

specs.name: mp_get_game_state
specs.description: [Multiplayer] Get the current multiplayer game state. Returns a summary of all players (HP, gold, alive status) plus full detail for the local player (relics, potions, deck, etc.), along with multiplayer-specific data: map votes, event votes, treasure bids, end-turn ready status. Only works during a multiplayer run. Args: format: "markdown" for human-readable output, "json" for structured data.

specs.name: mp_combat_play_card
specs.description: [Multiplayer Combat] Play a card from the local player's hand. Same as singleplayer combat_play_card but routed through the multiplayer endpoint for sync safety. Args: card_index: Index of the card in hand (0-based). target: Entity ID of the target enemy (e.g. "JAW_WORM_0"). Required for single-target cards.

specs.name: mp_combat_end_turn
specs.description: [Multiplayer Combat] Submit end-turn vote. In multiplayer, ending the turn is a VOTE — the turn only ends when ALL players have submitted. Use mp_combat_undo_end_turn() to retract.

specs.name: mp_combat_undo_end_turn
specs.description: [Multiplayer Combat] Retract end-turn vote. If you submitted end turn but want to play more cards, use this to undo. Only works if other players haven't all committed yet.

specs.name: mp_use_potion
specs.description: [Multiplayer] Use a potion from the local player's potion slots. Args: slot: Potion slot index (as shown in game state). target: Entity ID of the target enemy. Required for enemy-targeted potions.

specs.name: mp_discard_potion
specs.description: [Multiplayer] Discard a potion from the local player's potion slots to free up space. Args: slot: Potion slot index to discard (as shown in game state).

specs.name: mp_map_vote
specs.description: [Multiplayer Map] Vote for a map node to travel to. In multiplayer, map selection is a vote — travel happens when all players agree. Re-voting for the same node sends a ping to other players. Args: node_index: 0-based index of the node from the next_options list.

specs.name: mp_event_choose_option
specs.description: [Multiplayer Event] Choose or vote for an event option. For shared events: this is a vote (resolves when all players vote). For individual events: immediate choice, same as singleplayer. Args: option_index: 0-based index of the option from the event state.

specs.name: mp_event_advance_dialogue
specs.description: [Multiplayer Event] Advance ancient event dialogue.

specs.name: mp_rest_choose_option
specs.description: [Multiplayer Rest Site] Choose a rest site option (rest, smith, etc.). Per-player choice — no voting needed. Args: option_index: 0-based index of the option.

specs.name: mp_shop_purchase
specs.description: [Multiplayer Shop] Purchase an item from the shop. Per-player inventory — no voting needed. Args: item_index: 0-based index of the item.

specs.name: mp_rewards_claim
specs.description: [Multiplayer Rewards] Claim a reward from the post-combat rewards screen. Args: reward_index: 0-based index of the reward.

specs.name: mp_rewards_pick_card
specs.description: [Multiplayer Rewards] Select a card from the card reward screen. Args: card_index: 0-based index of the card to add to the deck.

specs.name: mp_rewards_skip_card
specs.description: [Multiplayer Rewards] Skip the card reward.

specs.name: mp_proceed_to_map
specs.description: [Multiplayer] Proceed from the current screen to the map. Works from: rewards screen, rest site, shop.

specs.name: mp_deck_select_card
specs.description: [Multiplayer Card Selection] Select or deselect a card in the card selection screen. Args: card_index: 0-based index of the card.

specs.name: mp_deck_confirm_selection
specs.description: [Multiplayer Card Selection] Confirm the current card selection.

specs.name: mp_deck_cancel_selection
specs.description: [Multiplayer Card Selection] Cancel the current card selection.

specs.name: mp_bundle_select
specs.description: [Multiplayer Bundle Selection] Open a bundle preview. Args: bundle_index: 0-based index of the bundle.

specs.name: mp_bundle_confirm_selection
specs.description: [Multiplayer Bundle Selection] Confirm the currently previewed bundle.

specs.name: mp_bundle_cancel_selection
specs.description: [Multiplayer Bundle Selection] Cancel the current bundle preview.

specs.name: mp_combat_select_card
specs.description: [Multiplayer Combat Selection] Select a card from hand during in-combat card selection. Args: card_index: 0-based index of the card in the selectable hand cards.

specs.name: mp_combat_confirm_selection
specs.description: [Multiplayer Combat Selection] Confirm the in-combat card selection.

specs.name: mp_relic_select
specs.description: [Multiplayer Relic Selection] Select a relic (boss relic rewards). Args: relic_index: 0-based index of the relic.

specs.name: mp_relic_skip
specs.description: [Multiplayer Relic Selection] Skip the relic selection.

specs.name: mp_treasure_claim_relic
specs.description: [Multiplayer Treasure] Bid on / claim a relic from the treasure chest. In multiplayer, this is a bid — if multiple players pick the same relic, a "relic fight" determines the winner. Others get consolation prizes. Args: relic_index: 0-based index of the relic.

specs.description: [Multiplayer Crystal Sphere] Switch the active divination tool. Args: tool: Either "big" or "small".

specs.name: mp_crystal_sphere_click_cell
specs.description: [Multiplayer Crystal Sphere] Click a hidden cell on the Crystal Sphere grid. Args: x: Cell x-coordinate. y: Cell y-coordinate.

specs.name: unity_profiler_enable
specs.description: Enable or disable the Unity Profiler. Optionally enable deep profiling for detailed call stacks (has significant performance overhead, and switching it can trigger a script reload in the editor).

specs.description: Get current rendering statistics: draw calls, batches, triangles, vertices, set-pass calls, frame time, render time, shadow casters, and more. The profiler does NOT need to be enabled for this â€” stats come from UnityStats which is always available.

specs.name: unity_profiler_memory
specs.description: Get detailed memory usage breakdown: total allocated, reserved, Mono heap used/size, graphics driver memory, temp allocator size, and GC info. Values are returned in both bytes and human-readable MB.

specs.name: unity_profiler_frame_data
specs.description: Get CPU profiler frame data as a hierarchical timing breakdown. Shows function names, total/self time, call counts, and GC allocations. The profiler must be enabled and have captured at least one frame.

specs.name: unity_profiler_analyze
specs.description: Run a comprehensive performance analysis combining memory, rendering stats, profiler frame data, and scene complexity. Returns optimization suggestions based on configurable thresholds (e.g. too many batches, high triangle count, excessive set-pass calls, GPU memory usage, shadow casters).

specs.name: unity_debugger_enable

specs.name: unity_debugger_event_details
specs.description: Get detailed information about a specific Frame Debugger event: shader name, pass, keywords, vertex/index/instance counts, render target, batch break cause, and mesh info. The Frame Debugger must be enabled first.

specs.name: unity_memory_status

specs.name: unity_memory_top_assets

specs.name: unity_memory_snapshot

specs.name: unity_shadergraph_status

specs.name: unity_shader_get_properties

specs.name: unity_shadergraph_remove_node
specs.description: Remove a node from a Shader Graph by its ID. Also removes all edges connected to the node.

specs.name: unity_shadergraph_connect
specs.description: Connect two nodes in a Shader Graph by creating an edge between an output slot and an input slot.

specs.name: unity_shadergraph_disconnect
specs.description: Disconnect two nodes in a Shader Graph by removing the edge between them.

specs.name: unity_shadergraph_set_node_property
specs.description: Set a property value on a Shader Graph node. Can modify any serialized property like color values, float inputs, vector components, etc.

specs.name: unity_shadergraph_get_node_types
specs.description: List all available Shader Graph node types by reflecting over the ShaderGraph assembly. Returns type names, categories, and full class names. Useful for discovering available nodes before adding them.

specs.name: unity_amplify_open

specs.description: Create a new Amplify shader from a predefined template (surface, unlit, urp_lit, transparent, post_process). The shader file is created and can then be opened in ASE.

specs.name: list_table_config
specs.description: List every configuration artifact on a table — business rules, client scripts, UI policies, ACLs, UI actions, data policies, and dictionary fields — with per-type counts. Use it to see what depends on a table before changing or removing it. This is config/metadata impact, not CMDB CI impact. Each lane returns {count, records} or {error} if that table/plugin is unavailable.

specs.name: find_field_references
specs.description: Find where a table field is used — its dictionary entry plus any scripts (business rules, script includes, client scripts, UI actions, widgets) that mention the field name. Use it before renaming or removing a field. Script matches are substring (LIKE) hits, so expect false positives (comments, similarly-named symbols) and misses for dynamically-built references; treat results as candidates to rev

specs.name: find_script_references
specs.description: Find what references a Script Include or named artifact — scans script-bearing config tables for textual use of the name. Use it before renaming or deleting a Script Include, Script Action, etc. Matches are substring (LIKE) hits, so treat them as candidates to review (false positives from comments/similar names; misses for dynamic references).

specs.name: find_property_usage

specs.name: list_supported_artifacts
specs.description: Local sync: list the artifact types (tables) that support pull/push to local files and which fields sync for each.

specs.name: pull_artifact
specs.description: Local sync: fetch an artifact\'s editable fields (e.g. a Service Portal widget\'s template/css/script) for local editing. Returns the content inline; when NOWAIKIT_SYNC_DIR is set it also writes one file per field and returns the paths. This is config/pro-code editing of a single artifact, not an update-set export.

specs.name: push_artifact
specs.description: Local sync: write edited fields back to an artifact (requires WRITE_ENABLED=true). Pass fields inline as {field:value}; if omitted and NOWAIKIT_SYNC_DIR is set, reads them from the pulled files on disk. Overwrites the listed fields with NO merge — run sync_status first, and pass expected_updated_on to abort if the instance changed since you pulled.

specs.name: sync_status
specs.description: Local sync: compare an artifact\'s current instance content against your local/edited content field-by-field. Each field reports unchanged | changed | not_local (no local copy to compare). Also returns sys_updated_on to feed into push_artifact\'s conflict check.
